mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, chapter_id, ccct_item_id, content, question_type, cognitive_level_code, difficulty, status, source_type, created_by, ready_by, ready_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.question_bank_items WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{itemId}
SELECT id, question_bank_item_id, content, is_correct, explanation, order_index, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.question_bank_answers WHERE question_bank_item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY order_index
SELECT learning_outcome_id FROM edu.question_bank_item_learning_outcomes WHERE question_bank_item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY learning_outcome_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.question_bank_items (id, course_id, chapter_id, ccct_item_id, content, question_type, cognitive_level_code, difficulty, status, source_type, created_by, ready_by, ready_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{ccctItemId}, #{content}, #{questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{cognitiveLevelCode}, #{difficulty}, #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.questionbank.QuestionBankItemStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.questionbank.QuestionBankSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{readyBy}, #{readyAt}, #{version}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.question_bank_items SET chapter_id = #{item.chapterId}, ccct_item_id = #{item.ccctItemId}, content = #{item.content}, question_type = #{item.questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, cognitive_level_code = #{item.cognitiveLevelCode}, difficulty = #{item.difficulty}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{item.id} AND course_id = #{item.courseId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
